$lanes: One lane, run both ways (no keep-right lanes yet: OPEN-QUESTIONS #1). The average of five crossings' AIS tracks (a screenshot of sthuqi''s and spuhéls's tracks, Braden, 2026-11-02): mid-strait the tracks spread over ~2 km and the line is their median, smoothed over ±3 km; out of Nanaimo and from First Narrows to Coal Harbour, where the tracks run together, it follows them. Georeferenced on the two terminals and Lions Gate Bridge (fit: 25 m/px, ±170 m), so ±200 m; the point under Lions Gate Bridge is mid-channel, read off the basemap.
